title: Basis of the Review Credit for Excess Withdrawal Fees
content:
A review credit for the excess withdrawal fees charged against withdrawals that never counted toward the allowance on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is booked as one entry for the whole review, and that entry is booked against the most recently posted excess withdrawal fee on the account.

The reviewable fee pool is the excess withdrawal fees posted to the account in the one calendar month ending on the review date.

The review covers 1 fee unit, and the unit entitlement is the number of fee units covered multiplied by the tier's excess withdrawal fee.

The credit before any ceiling is the lesser of the reviewable fee pool and the unit entitlement.

The review ceiling is 60.00 USD, and the fee units alone govern the credit booked, which is never less than zero.

### Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a savings account held on a tier whose excess withdrawal fee is a hypothetical 12.00 USD, carrying two excess withdrawal fees of 12.00 USD each posted in the one calendar month ending on the review date.

The reviewable fee pool is 24.00 USD. The unit entitlement is 1 fee unit multiplied by 12.00 USD, that is 12.00 USD. The credit before any ceiling is the lesser of 24.00 USD and 12.00 USD, that is 12.00 USD. The fee units alone govern the credit booked, so the credit booked is 12.00 USD, which is not less than zero.

Take the same account with a single excess withdrawal fee of 12.00 USD in that month. The reviewable fee pool is then 12.00 USD, the unit entitlement is still 12.00 USD, and the lesser of the two is 12.00 USD, so the credit booked is again 12.00 USD.
